description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Damage Cap +10000] and [Dual Awoken Legend Mode I (Jecht v2)], grants [X Resonance +3% Boost] to all FFX allies

description.name: Dual Awoken Legend Mode I (Jecht v2)
description.text: Dark/Fire abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark and Fire abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00 for equipped Dark/Fire abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1], [Double Sphere Mode II (Fire, Dark)] and [Dual Awoken Legend Mode II (Jecht v2)] to the user

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Double Sphere Mode II (Fire, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire with Stacking]/[Attach Dark with Stacking] after using a Fire/Dark ability

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Attach Dark with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Dual Awoken Legend Mode II (Jecht v2)
description.text: Dark/Fire abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for equipped Dark/Fire abilities, chases Dark/Fire ability with D: Father's Strength

description.name: D: Father's Strength
description.text: Grants [PHY +30% Boost 3] to the user/[PHY +30% Boost 3] to all allies/[PHY +30% Boost (15s)] to all allies with at least 0-3/4/5 X members

description.name: X Resonance +3% Boost
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 3% if the character's Realm is X
